C-8 / case-sensitive strings / 2 October 2026
PTP = saved promise; no reason
Settled = all products already paid and no promise; no reason
ToDesk = H-1 (human); queue PM-Desk
No-PTP = R-1 (refused/no eligible date), R-7 (disputed), E-9 (save failed)
IDStop = I-1 (failed), I-2 (declined)
NotHere = U-0 (unclear holder), C-0 (no callback), C-1 (callback scheduled), W-0 (wrong number), D-0 (deceased)
Notes only: R-1, R-7, S-1 (already paid), E-9. S-1 is a NOTE code, not a close reason.
No other queues or codes. Human transfer overrides every payment outcome.
